		NOT = { has_war_with = PUK }
	}

		NOT = {
			KUR = {
				exists = yes
				any_owned_state = {
					OR = { state = 164 state = 633 state = 630 state = 1078 }
				}
			}
		}
		KUR = { is_subject_of = IRQ has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_consent }
	}
	OR = {
		NOT = {
			PUK = {
				exists = yes

				}
			}
		}

	}
}
